dodge_roll.notes: 8-frame somersault/dodge roll. Frames use transformed original directional walking sprites; no weapons or props.

swing_notes: No weapon, tool, projectile, or accessory is present.
Arm and fist poses are sourced from the original four-frame walking sprite set.
Only changed pixels inside direction-specific arm/hand regions are composited over the neutral directional frame.
The head, backpack, torso center, and legs remain anchored to the original neutral pose.
Pose order: neutral, wind-up/guard, mid-extension, full extension, recoil, neutral.
